name: MIPL CRM/API Integration for WooCommerce
author: Mulika Team

sections.description:
“MIPL CRM/API Integration for WooCommerce” is a powerful WordPress plugin that seamlessly connects your WooCommerce store with any CRM system or REST API endpoint. Automatically synchronize Products, Orders, Customers, and Coupons between WooCommerce and your chosen CRM platform, eliminating manual data entry and optimizing your e-commerce workflow automation.

Features

  1. Universal CRM & API Integration – Easily connect WooCommerce with any CRM system or third-party REST API endpoint.
  2. WooCommerce Data Sync – Automatically sync WooCommerce Products, Orders, Customers, and Coupons in real-time.
  3. Custom Field Mapping – Map WooCommerce data fields directly to your CRM fields to ensure accurate and structured data transfer.
  4. Multiple Entity Support – Configure separate, individual integration rules for Products, Orders, Customers, and Coupons based on your business requirements.
  5. Advanced Authentication Methods – Supports API Key, Bearer Token, Basic Auth, OAuth 2.0, JWT, and OAuth 2.0 + JWT authentication for secure connectivity.
  6. REST API Support – Fully compatible with modern CRM platforms and custom endpoints using JSON, XML, Multipart, or URL-encoded content types.
  7. Real-time Data Transfer – Instantly trigger data payloads to your CRM or API upon WooCommerce store events, ensuring data is never lost.
  8. Easy Configuration – Setup your mapping rules and API headers using a code-free, intuitive admin interface.

External Services

This plugin can send WooCommerce data to Zapier when the Zapier integration is configured and enabled by the site administrator.

When Zapier integration is used, the plugin sends the configured WooCommerce data to the Zapier webhook URL entered by the administrator. Zapier processes the data and can forward it to other services configured in the user’s Zapier account. The data sent depends on the fields selected in the plugin’s field mapping and integration settings.

Zapier is an external service and is not required for the custom CRM/API integration features. Please review Zapier’s policies before using this integration:

  • Zapier Terms of Service
  • Zapier Privacy Policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install it directly via the WordPress Plugins admin screen.
  2. Activate the plugin from the ‘Plugins’ menu in your WordPress admin dashboard.
  3. Navigate to the new MIPL CRM menu in your dashboard and configure your API/CRM connection endpoints and authentication credentials.
  4. Go to the Mapping section to map your core WooCommerce fields (Products, Orders, Customers, or Coupons) to your external CRM parameters.
  5. Save your settings and use the built-in CRM Test Tool to verify that data flows correctly from WooCommerce to your CRM.
